tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an entry on the user's own calendar. No other people are invited. Use this for the user's own calendar entries. For meetings that invite other people, use `schedule_event`. For reserving a meeting room, use `book_event`. For to-do list tasks, use `add_event`.

tools.name: schedule_event
tools.description: Set up a meeting with other people and email them invitations. Use this for meetings that invite other people. For the user's own calendar entries, use `create_event`. For reserving a meeting room, use `book_event`. For to-do list tasks, use `add_event`.

tools.name: book_event
tools.description: Reserve a meeting room for a time slot. Does not add anything to a calendar. Use this for reserving a meeting room. For the user's own calendar entries, use `create_event`. For meetings that invite other people, use `schedule_event`. For to-do list tasks, use `add_event`.

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Add a task with a due date to the user's to-do list. Does not create calendar entries. Use this for to-do list tasks. For the user's own calendar entries, use `create_event`. For meetings that invite other people, use `schedule_event`. For reserving a meeting room, use `book_event`.
